hero.title: Train your body, explore your soul
hero.lede: Yoga and pilates retreats in small groups, set in the stone architecture of Assos.

manifesto.title: Rest is not a luxury. It is a necessity.
manifesto.body1: Serenity Retreats promises the opposite of a crowded schedule: morning practice, long meals, and quiet hours spent between the sea and the olive groves. Every camp is held at the same stone hotel, with the same small team, at the same unhurried pace.
manifesto.body2: You are not arriving at a class — you are arriving at a retreat. We set the structure; you set the rest — your breath, your pace, your quiet.

items.1: Accommodation in a stone hotel, shared room
items.2: Two yoga or pilates sessions a day
items.3: Three home-style, seasonal meals a day
items.5: Walks to Assos and Kadırga Bay

deepenPractice.title: Deepen Your Practice
deepenPractice.body: Morning and evening sessions run in groups that never exceed sixteen people. Our teachers know every body starts from a different place; the program is open from complete beginners to advanced practitioners.
deepenPractice.imageAlt: View over the olive groves from the stone hotel's balcony

nourishBody.title: Nourish Your Body
nourishBody.body: Our kitchen follows the season: olive oil, homemade cheese, vegetables from the garden. All three meals are eaten at a shared table, unhurried.
nourishBody.imageAlt: The hotel's garden, surrounded by olive trees

resetMind.title: Reset Your Mind
resetMind.body: Phones are set aside. Breathwork, long silences and empty hours by the pool give the mind the rest it actually needs.
resetMind.imageAlt: The hotel's pool and rest area

newsletter.title: Be the first to hear about new camps
newsletter.lede: We'll email you as soon as new dates are announced — before spots fill up.
newsletter.consent: I have read the KVKK Privacy Notice and consent to being contacted by email.
